node.statement: Fix once and for all the global header W_RF given by lem-routef-scalar-header-positivity.  For this same header, eta_K is universal and positive and the threshold consequences needed below are eta_K <= rho_id^corr, eta_K <= rho_Delta', eta_K <= rho_Delta, eta_K <= rho_Upsilon', and eta_K <= rho_Upsilon.
